description: Pylônes électriques [BD TOPO®] - République Isogeo is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by BUREAU DE RECHERCHES GÉOLOGIQUES ET MINIÈRES. Definition of the IGN: Support in metal frame or concrete, of an overhead power line. Selection: All pylons or gantries built to support a power line of at least 63 kV shall be included. Coverage: FR. Its keywords include national, ign, portiques, support, lignes électriques, pylônes. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
